votes.motion: Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Barney, moved to approve the minutes of the Magna Metro Township Council meetings held on August 9, 2022, and August 16, 2022
Council Member Barney, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to table discussions of the Emergency Manager designation and Emergency Communications Plan until the October 11, 2022, Council meeting
Council Member Barney, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to table approval of the contract with N&W Enterprises, LLC, to allow enough time to gather additional information
Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Barney, moved to approve the RFP for the Pleasant Green Cemetery sign
Council Member Barney, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to approve Resolution 22-09-04, approving and authorizing the execution of a lease agreement with the Webster Community Center
